footer.ctaText: Looking for a private AI solution for your company?

home.title: Your Data. Your AI. Your Rules.
home.subtitle: Deploy your own AI platform, fully private and modular. Your data stays in your hands — your models, your knowledge, your infrastructure. No external servers, no hidden costs.

hero.title: Your Data. Your AI. Your Rules.
hero.subtitle: Deploy your own AI platform, fully private and modular. Your data stays in your hands — your models, your knowledge, your infrastructure. No external servers, no hidden costs.

hero.title: Your AI, your rules
hero.subtitle: Sentra Brain is the private AI server that puts control back in your hands.

problem.title: The Problem
problem.text: Using cloud-based AI means giving away your data, intellectual property, and exposing your clients. Regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or ISO27001 are clear: your data must remain under control.

solution.title: The Solution
solution.text: With Sentra Brain, install your own local or hybrid AI server, customizable and fully private. No external dependencies, no hidden fees.

benefit1.title: Total Privacy
benefit1.text: Your AI runs within your network. Fully compliant with GDPR, HIPAA and more.

benefit2.title: Flexible Integration
benefit2.text: Connect with CRM, ERP, n8n and your custom workflows.

benefit3.title: No Limits
benefit3.text: Local models, no restricted tokens or pay-per-use costs.

hero.title: Modular Architecture
hero.subtitle: Sentra Brain combines LLM serving, secure integrations, document search, automations, and full control in one system.

llm.title: LLM Serving Engine
llm.text: Run large language models locally or hybrid. Compatible with private GPT, Qwen, Llama and many more.

mcp.title: MCP Integration
mcp.text: Secure API layer for CRM, ERP, Office plugins and internal systems.

rag.title: Document Search (RAG)
rag.text: Connect your knowledge base with private document search powered by RAG technology.

automation.title: Custom Automations
automation.text: Integrate workflows and actions using tools like n8n, adapted to your processes.

security.title: Enterprise-Grade Security
security.text: Deploy on-prem or hybrid. Fully compliant with GDPR, HIPAA, ISO27001.

support.title: Certified Hardware & Support
support.text: Official packages with Sentra Brain-certified hardware and professional consulting.

hero.title: Real Companies, Real Solutions
hero.subtitle: Discover how Sentra Brain adapts to multiple sectors with privacy-first AI.

general-business.title: Any Professional Environment
